checks.purpose: Validate the closed Definition/v1 representation and exact schema binding.
Require scientific/formal, explicitly non-normative plain-language, and Lab domain-context voices.
Resolve every exact source selector and require admitted source posture for promotion.
blocked_by: missing or stale selected source admission

checks.purpose: Resolve semantic owner and drift owner through current role assignments.
Prove two-run deterministic generation and exact projection parity.
Validate the proposed registry postimage, unique identity, generated index, and drift audit.
blocked_by: missing registry postimage or drift audit

checks.purpose: Verify that one human decision binds all admission-bound candidate and postimage digests.

admission_rule: A Definition is eligible for an admission decision only when checks 01 through 06 PASS and check 07 is NOT_EVALUABLE solely because the owner decision has not yet occurred. PASS remains evidence and cannot perform the admission.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines collect-all evaluation semantics. An evaluation result has authority_effect none and cannot admit, publish, implement, or prove semantic truth.
